newsitem.title: USA: Sanctuary Woods says CEO Walker resigns.
newsitem.headline: Sanctuary Woods says CEO Walker resigns.

text.p: Sanctuary Woods Multimedia Corp, a developer of educational-based software, Tuesday announced the resignation of President and Chief Executive Officer Charlotte Walker.
In a statement, the company said Walker resigned, effective July 24, to pursue other opportunities.

While the company searches for a permanent replacement, Marylyn Rosenblum has become acting president and chief executive. She formerly had been acting executive vice president of education at Sanctuary Woods.
Rosenblum has over 20 years of experience in managing sales, marketing, public relations, and product development in educational multimedia.
She has held the position of Vice President of Education Sales and Marketing at both Softkey International Inc and Broderbund Software Inc.
